title: RecordTransitionPayload
description: Payload for `record transition` — the updated record and any non-fatal warnings (e.g., LIFECYCLE_FINAL_STATE). Envelope `diagnostics` is reserved for `ok: false` errors; non-fatal operational signals on a successful response belong in the typed payload per ADR-011. When the transition was fulfilled (RFC-022), `successor` / `relation` carry the artifacts.

diagnosticsStructured.description: `warnings` as structured findings, entry for entry (ADR-057, srs-rust#1339).

DiagnosticPayload.description: One structured finding, beside the text `diagnostics` list on the render, find, container view, blueprint, navigation and type_schema surfaces (srs-rust#1491, ADR-057). Mirrors `diagnostic::Diagnostic`. `message` is the text-list entry verbatim.

code.description: The stable rule identifier, in today's spelling.
